title: Conformal Cyclic Cosmology
description: At the end of time only massless things remain, and massless things cannot tell an infinite distance from a finite one. Rescale the dead universe and its infinite future becomes the Big Bang of the next aeon. Where Finality ends, Origin begins: make a Universe Seed from the end of a universe.

puzzle.goal: Light does not care about the size of space, only about its shape: it moves through conformal time, the integral of c dt divided by the scale factor a(t). In a universe that ends in pure vacuum energy, a(t) = a₀ e^{Ht} grows exponentially forever. Write how much conformal time is left from t₀ to the infinite future.
puzzle.name: conformal time to the future boundary of de Sitter space
puzzle.form: int ( t _ 0 , ∞ , c / ( a _ 0 * exp ( H * t ) ) , t )
puzzle.ask: The integral is finite: c e^{−Ht₀}/(a₀H). Measured from now (t₀ = 0, a₀ = a), and with the Hubble rate H in km/s/Mpc (1/H = 977.8/H Gyr), find the conformal time to the end of time, in Gyr.
puzzle.method: Change variable to u = e^{−Ht}; an exponential integrand gives an exponential back, and it vanishes at infinity.
